execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

walk_forward.fit: Fixed causal close-channel rules,no labels/model fit/perfold or OOS retuning;180day rolling history,3day gap,purge0,six30day diagnostic folds. Continuous balances and desired across folds;costed final exit.

forward_plan.status_at_freeze: Original SMA65/1percent75/25 delayed shadow collecting. Next decision Oct9UTC00:01. Original positions/trades/costs and actual-quote paper10 accounts remain separate and unchanged.

plan.hypothesis: Previous grids tested fast BTC/slow ETH and slow BTC/fast ETH. Test both assets using shorter but unequal exits: entry20 fixed in both;BTC exit10/20/30 crossed with ETH exit10/20/30. Unequal fast exits may diversify exit timing and reduce drawdown,or increase whipsaw/cost and forfeit long trends. Two off-diagonal fast pairs per year are genuinely new;the other seven cells per year are exact historical results read-only. Center BTCexit10/ETHexit20 is predeclared,not selected from new returns.

rules.entry: At daily decision i,use completed prior close C[i-1]. Strictly above max(C[i-entry_lookback_days-1:i-1]) sets desired-long. The entry comparison range contains exactly entry_lookback_days completed closes ending i-2;it EXCLUDES the tested close i-1.
rules.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-exit_lookback_days-1:i-1]) sets desired-cash. Exit range contains exactly exit_lookback_days closes ending i-2. Equality or neither event preserves desired-state. No shorting,buffer,volatility filter,confirmation,stop or pyramiding.
rules.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open, buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE floored quantity; keep leftover USDT. Sell all lot-valid held units when desired-cash or terminal. Failed orders do not change holdings and are retried at later daily decisions. No leverage, borrow, funding, transfers, rebalancing or USDT yield.

plan.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. All window timestamps end by i-2 daily completion;tested close available at UTC00:00 of decision day,trade reference next UTC00:01.
plan.allocation: Raw BTC/ETH75/25 denotes initial1500/500USDT independent sleeves of2000. Sum same-size already-costed absolute NAV once;no normalization,second weighting,transfers,maintained ratio or rebalance. Entry20 fixed;BTC/ETH exit windows independent.
plan.sensitivity: Two historical-year3x3 surfaces vary BTC and ETH exit windows10/20/30 simultaneously.4new exact portfolios reserved before calculation;14existing cells read-only without overwrite. All1/2/3costs,sixfolds,return,minute/daily drawdown,Sharpe,Calmar and12adjacent edges per surface retained.
plan.cross_period_confirmation: Identical entry20/BTCexit/ETHexit and75/25funding must pass EACH reused180day/sixfold period separately. No pooling,held-out final test or new independent data.
plan.qualification_scope: Original eight gates unchanged. All exact historical cells preserve original records/status/criteria. All4new variants plus3legacy cutoffs independently registered.
plan.interpretation: Repeated development history and many trials;new exit assignments are not independent market evidence,statistical significance or stable live profit. No fixed-paper portfolio replacement.

curve_formula.day_offsets: d=0..179; initial vector[0]=capital; post-decision reference NAV at[d*1441+1]; closed minute marks[d*1441+2:(d+1)*1441+1] use close source[(183+d)*1440+1:(184+d)*1440+1]; terminal vector[-1]=terminal_cash+terminal_units*terminal_open. Component Decimal cash/qty converted to float64 for minute multiplication; post/terminal Decimal before float conversion.
curve_formula.timestamps: vector[0]=start pre-trade; [d*1441+1] same decision timestamp post-trade; next1440 entries available_ts of real minute closes strictly after decision through next day00:01. Terminal final duplicate boundary after liquidation. Combination = elementwise sum of exact already-sized component vectors; no reweighting.
